stem: A test has a baseline conversion of 10% and 40,000 users per variant. Using the rearranged Lehr's rule, MDE (absolute) ≈ 4 × sqrt(p(1 - p) / n) with n users per variant (an approximation for 80% power and a two-sided 5% significance level), what is the MDE as a relative lift on the baseline? Give it in percent with 1 decimal.
